name: Yörünge İstasyonu
scene: An orbital station with broad solar wings floats above a planetary horizon beside an ascending rocket and a spacewalking astronaut.
notes: Redrawn from grand_13 with lighthouse and hot-air-balloon design style references. Target 110–160 panes. Warm pair reserved for station, rocket and astronaut; cool pair for space and planet. Visually reviewed initial generation and one revision: revision removes antenna and several narrow collars, simplifies chest detail and supplies white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle fill variation persists; some same-colour neighbours will merge in tracing; solar-wing seam intersections and a few close station/astronaut junctions need geometry review. Pane count is a design target, not a verified traced count. Design sheet only; no game geometry or catalogue changes.
